wiki.title: Trolls
wiki.text:
Trolls are a sentient race that mainly reside in the Forest Troll Village.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of trolls in any locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Regular trolls can be found in any locations expect Snowhill. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses.

Ice trolls can be found in Snowhill, they have light blue skins, large ears, big noses, and red eyes.
